Update the optional Chasen adapter to Chasen **v0.1.2**.

Requires Zig **0.16.0**.

## Changed

- Pin the optional Chasen dependency to
  [v0.1.2](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/releases/tag/v0.1.2), including
  Chasen's timer, text rendering, and input lifecycle fixes since the previous pin.
- Add macOS CI coverage alongside Linux for the existing core tests, adapter
  tests, terminal image example build, and Braille mask example.

## Compatibility

Graphics APIs and implementation are unchanged. The core `chasen_graphics`
module continues to use only the Zig standard library.

Custom POSIX `std.Io` users of the optional adapter should check Chasen's
[terminal capacity requirements](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/blob/v0.1.2/docs/RUNTIME.md#runtime-configuration).
See the [upstream changes](https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen/compare/fbede8063440535a01a4f5d3b42511657d231837...v0.1.2)
for the dependency update.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hiroaqii/chasen-graphics/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
